
## Modèle de Pull Request

Ajoute dans `.github/pull_request_template.md` :

```markdown
## Summary

Describe the purpose and scope of this change.

## Change type

- [ ] Application
- [ ] Test
- [ ] CI/CD
- [ ] Container
- [ ] Kubernetes
- [ ] Security
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Maintenance

## Validation

Describe the commands or tests used to validate the change.

- [ ] Local checks completed
- [ ] Automated tests added or updated when applicable
- [ ] No secrets or sensitive data committed
- [ ] Documentation updated when applicable

## Deployment impact

Describe any configuration change, migration, downtime, or rollback requirement.

## Related issue

Closes #
